collection.title: BMW 4-Series Convertible 2021 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A BMW 4 Series Convertible 2021 Onwards requires a 24" wiper blade on the driver's side with a 19" for the passenger's side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
